evolve.job_cement_worker_desc: Cement Workers turn stone into cement. Each worker produces %1$s cement and consumes %2$s stone per second.
evolve.evo_dna_desc: Creates a new strand of DNA
evolve.evo_nucleus_effect: Automatically consume 2 RNA to create %1$s DNA.
evolve.evo_mitochondria_effect: Increases the effect of membranes and eukaryotic cells.
evolve.evo_phagocytosis_effect: Evolve in the direction of the animal kingdom. This is a major evolutionary fork.
evolve.evo_chloroplasts_effect: Evolve in the direction of the plant kingdom. This is a major evolutionary fork.
evolve.evo_chitin_effect: Evolve in the direction of the fungi kingdom. This is a major evolutionary fork.
evolve.evo_exterminate_effect: Sanitize organic matter sample to prevent contamination of machine parts. This ends evolution.
evolve.evo_multicellular_effect: Decreases cost of producing new nucleus.
evolve.evo_athropods_effect: Evolve in the direction of arthropods. This is an evolutionary fork.
evolve.evo_mammals_effect: Evolve in the direction of mammals. This is an evolutionary fork.
evolve.evo_humanoid_effect: Evolve in the direction of humanoids. This is an evolutionary fork.
evolve.evo_gigantism_effect: Evolve in the direction of gigantism. This is an evolutionary fork.
evolve.evo_dwarfism_effect: Evolve in the direction of dwarfism. This is an evolutionary fork.
evolve.evo_animalism_effect: Evolve in the direction of beasts. This is an evolutionary fork.
evolve.evo_carnivore_effect: Evolve in the direction of carnivorous beasts. This is an evolutionary fork.
evolve.evo_herbivore_effect: Evolve in the direction of herbivorous beasts. This is an evolutionary fork.
evolve.evo_omnivore_effect: Evolve in the direction of omnivorous beasts. This is an evolutionary fork.
evolve.evo_demonic_effect: Evolve in the direction of demons. This is an evolutionary fork.
evolve.evo_eldritch_effect: Evolve in the direction of Eldritch horrors. This is an evolutionary fork.
evolve.evo_celestial_effect: Evolve in the direction of celestials. This is an evolutionary fork.
evolve.evo_eggshell_effect: Evolve in the direction of eggshells. This is an evolutionary fork.
evolve.evo_endothermic_effect: Evolve in the direction of avians. This is an evolutionary fork.
evolve.evo_ectothermic_effect: Evolve in the direction of reptiles. This is an evolutionary fork.
evolve.evo_warn_unwise: This evolution is not recommended for this planet type!
evolve.evo_aquatic_effect: Evolve in the direction of marine life. This is an evolutionary fork.
evolve.evo_fey_effect: Evolve in the direction of fey. This is an evolutionary fork.
evolve.evo_heat_effect: Evolve in the direction of heat-resistant life. This is an evolutionary fork.
evolve.evo_polar_effect: Evolve in the direction of cold-resistant life. This is an evolutionary fork.
evolve.evo_sand_effect: Evolve in the direction of desert life. This is an evolutionary fork.
evolve.evo_synthetic_effect: Evolve in the direction of synthetic life. This is an evolutionary fork.
evolve.evo_sentience_effect: Complete your evolution by evolving into a species which has achieved sentience.
evolve.evo_sentience_ai_effect: Use a random number generator to design your synthetic race.
evolve.evo_pick_race: Evolve into a %1$s. This completes evolution.
evolve.evo_bunker_flair: Set down the path of Bunker
evolve.evo_challenge: Opens the challenge mode gene pool
evolve.evo_challenge_genes_desc: Each Challenge Gene activated increases the quality of achievements earned.
evolve.evo_challenge_genes_mastery: Higher-quality achievements are worth more mastery.
evolve.evo_challenge_run_desc: Challenge modes are game runs with special rules; each challenge is unique and has its own conditions and reward.
evolve.evo_scenario_desc: Scenarios are games that have special starting conditions. Scenarios always enforce max difficulty and may significantly change gameplay. Scenarios cannot be combined.
evolve.evo_challenge_mastery_effect: Mastery is much weaker than normal.
evolve.evo_challenge_trade_effect: No marketplace trading. (Trade routes are still enabled.)
evolve.evo_challenge_crispr_effect: Gain a random negative mutation. CRISPR cost creep discounts function at only 20%%.
evolve.evo_challenge_nerfed_effect: Mastery is reduced to %1$s, and plasmid and anti-plasmid production are reduced to %2$s value. Plasmid and anti-plasmid storage bonus reduced to %3$s. Phage storage bonus reduced to %4$s.
evolve.evo_challenge_badgenes_effect: Gain %1$s random empowered negative trait and %2$s weak negative traits.
evolve.evo_challenge_junker_desc: You're a genetic disaster, and inherit nothing but terrible traits from virtually every other race.
evolve.evo_challenge_junker_effect: This forces on all four challenge genes. You will be stacked with horrible junk traits. Reach MAD for a special perk.
evolve.evo_challenge_junker_conditions: MAD reset to win the challenge.
evolve.evo_challenge_scenario_warn: Warning: you have low Mastery. This Scenario is not recommended at this time!
evolve.evo_challenge_scenario_failwarn: This challenge can end in total failure.
evolve.evo_challenge_cataclysm_desc: A cataclysm has destroyed your homeworld. You must survive without terrestrial resources.
evolve.evo_challenge_cataclysm_effect: A massive earthquake has literally shaken your planet apart. Start with a space colony but no homeworld. Escape to a new world to win (Bioseed).
evolve.evo_challenge_cataclysm_warn: This scenario is very slow-paced. Not recommended for players with low prestige rewards.
evolve.evo_challenge_cataclysm_condition: Bioseed or Cataclysm reset to win the challenge.
evolve.evo_challenge_joyless_effect: There will be no joy in your life: entertainers and broadcasting are disabled. Construct a Biodome to earn the achievement and remove the penalty.
evolve.evo_challenge_joyless_flair: There is no joy in this life
evolve.evo_challenge_joyless_conditions: Construct a Biodome to complete the challenge.
evolve.evo_challenge_steelen_effect: Your species cannot figure out how to smelt Steel. You have to resort to other means to get any of it. Have the mettle to Bioseed with this challenge active and your dedication will be rewarded.
evolve.evo_challenge_steelen_conditions: Bioseed reset to complete the challenge.
evolve.evo_challenge_decay_desc: All matter in this universe is unstable and decays.
evolve.evo_challenge_decay_effect: Resources decay at a rate determined by how much of it you are storing. Larger stores decay quicker. Destroy this universe to end the cycle of decay.
evolve.evo_challenge_decay_flair: Decayed, but not forgotten. Who am I kidding? No one will remember you.
evolve.evo_challenge_decay_conditions: Blackhole reset to complete the challenge.
evolve.evo_challenge_banana_desc: Your economy is dependent on a single export.
evolve.evo_challenge_banana_effect: You can only export one type of resource, your economy is bad, and your army is weak. Complete a checklist of objectives; unifying exits the scenario.
evolve.evo_challenge_truepath_recap: You are progressing on an alternate path of reality.
evolve.evo_challenge_emfield_effect: Energy costs are higher and technology may fail you. You must ascend to win.
evolve.evo_challenge_emfield_conditions: Ascend reset to complete the challenge.
evolve.evo_challenge_inflation_desc: Prices are climbing out of control.
evolve.evo_challenge_inflation_effect: Inflation is ruining your economy. The more you build, the more worthless your money becomes. Constructing anything devalues money, causing all money costs to increase.
evolve.evo_challenge_inflation_condition: Acquire two hundred fifty billion worthless dollars.
evolve.evo_challenge_sludge_desc: You're a failed experiment; gain lots of awful traits and suffer terribly.
evolve.evo_challenge_sludge_effect: You will be stacked with terrible junk traits. You suffer for no reason.
evolve.evo_challenge_ultra_sludge_desc: You're an even worse failed experiment; gain lots of dreadful traits and suffer terribly.
evolve.evo_challenge_ultra_sludge_effect: You will be stacked with terrible junk traits. You suffer because the community wanted it.
evolve.evo_challenge_ultra_sludge_flair: Win? If you can call it that.
evolve.evo_challenge_fasting_desc: Your citizens can not eat food.
evolve.evo_challenge_fasting_effect: Food production is disabled. Learn to survive without sustenance.
evolve.evo_challenge_fasting_flair: I have no mouth and I must eat.
evolve.evo_challenge_orbit_decay_desc: The moon is in a decaying orbit.
evolve.evo_challenge_orbit_decay_impacte: The moon has collided with %1$s, destroying both.
evolve.evo_challenge_orbit_decay_effect: Your homeworlds' moon is in a decaying orbit; it will impact the planet in %1$s days.
evolve.evo_challenge_orbit_decay_flair: Why is the moon getting bigger?
evolve.evo_challenge_orbit_decayed_msg: The moon has fallen into %1$s and destroyed all life on the planet.
evolve.evo_challenge_orbit_decayed_accel: The Moon's orbit decay has suddenly accelerated; you have %1$s days remaining.
evolve.evo_challenge_nonstandard_desc: The standard universe is so dull that you must discover a new way to get rid of it.
evolve.evo_challenge_nonstandard_effect: There is nothing standard about this.
evolve.evo_challenge_nonstandard_flair: So dull... get me out of here!
evolve.evo_challenge_gravity_well_desc: Your home planet is an enormous gravity well. Escape is impossible... or is it?
evolve.evo_challenge_gravity_well_effect: Gravity is very strong, so leaving the planet will be very difficult. Find a new one that doesn't drag you down.
evolve.evo_challenge_gravity_well_flair: It's impressive you can even walk
evolve.evo_challenge_gravity_well_warn: This challenge requires more fuel storage than usual. It may be difficult or impossible to complete with your current spatial reasoning.
evolve.evo_challenge_witch_hunter_desc: Magic permeates the universe, but its use is considered taboo. As an underground mage you must practice in secret to avoid witch hunters.
evolve.evo_challenge_witch_hunter_effect: Magic effects are stronger, but using magic draws unwanted attention. Your goal is to perform the ultimate forbidden ritual.
evolve.evo_challenge_warlord_desc: You will be the greatest warlord to ever exist. Crush your enemies, eat their hearts, and drink from their skulls.
evolve.evo_challenge_warlord_effect: Prove you are the most ruthless to ever exist.
evolve.evo_challenge_warlord_warn: You can not complete this scenario unless you possess at least %1$s %2$s.
evolve.evo_challenge_lone_survivor_desc: You are the only member of your colony ship to survive the long journey to another star system.
evolve.evo_challenge_lone_survivor_effec: You must survive and thrive alone on an alien world.
evolve.evo_challenge_simulation_desc: All of life is a simulation, so nothing you do matters.
evolve.evo_challenge_simulation_effect: Everything you do is temporary. All Simulation progress is erased on exiting the simulation.
evolve.evo_challenge_simulation_topbar: You are living in a simulation. No progress will be kept from the simulation once leaving it.
evolve.evo_challenge_micro_warn: You will not get credit for completing this challenge in a micro universe.
evolve.city_rock_quarry_desc: Allows workers to quarry for stone
evolve.city_smelter_effect1: Smelters increase Iron yield by %1$s%% per smelter but require fuel to operate.
evolve.tech_bone_tools_desc: Create primitive tools out of animal bones
evolve.tech_farm_house_desc: Add a house to every farm
evolve.tech_foundry_effect: Design the foundry, a place for crafters to produce manufactured materials.
evolve.tech_artisans_effect: Crafters produce an extra 3%% for each Foundry.
evolve.tech_smelting_desc: Design smelting facilities to refine ore
evolve.tech_metal_working_desc: Learn the basics of smelting and metalworking
evolve.tech_storage_desc: Design a structure to house resources
evolve.tech_science_desc: Begin a journey of testing and discovery
evolve.tech_copper_axes_desc: Create an axe made from bronze
evolve.tech_iron_axes_desc: Create a sturdy axe made from iron
evolve.tech_copper_pickaxe_desc: Create a pickaxe made from bronze
evolve.tech_iron_pickaxe_desc: Create a pickaxe made from iron
evolve.tech_cement_desc: Learn how to turn stone into cement
evolve.race_protoplasm_desc: Your race has yet to evolve into a complex lifeform. Currently you're nothing but protoplasm in the primordial ooze.
evolve.race_human_desc: Humans are versatile creatures who are adept at bending the environment around them to suit their needs. They are an ambitious race who seek to expand their knowledge of the universe around them and build great empires.
evolve.race_zombie_desc: Zombies aren't so much a species as they are the shambling remains of a race who succumbed to a nightmarish virus. Yet somehow they continue to drone on.
evolve.race_elven_desc: Elves are typically tall and slender creatures with pointy ears, that tend to be reclusive but sharp of wit. Elves live long lives and often devote themselves to study, seeking answers to the deep fundamental questions of the universe.
evolve.race_xmas_elf_desc: Elves work in the workshop all year round to make toys for everyone. They are basically slave labor used by the red overlord to mass-manufacture his products.
evolve.race_orc_desc: Orcs tend to be large and muscular creatures who are slow of wit but contain immense brute strength. They typically try to solve problems with violence first, then seek a more rational solution only when that doesn't work.
evolve.race_cath_desc: The Cath are a feline race who are typically lazy. They are curious and love exploring the unknown. However, most Cath prefer to laze about rather than work hard.
evolve.race_wolven_desc: The Wolven are a canine race who usually move in organized packs. They are a highly social species and rarely undertake any task alone.
evolve.race_rabbit_desc: The Bunny are a hopping race of super-active lagomorphs. They multiply quickly and are hyperactive.
evolve.race_vulpine_desc: The %1$s are a playful species of %2$s fox. They are cunning and have a bushy tail.
evolve.race_chocolate_rabbit_desc: Chocolate Bunnies are so tasty that they engage in cannibalism. In a bunny eat bunny world you need to be ruthless to survive.
evolve.race_centaur_desc: Centaur are a species of horse creatures who have human-like upper bodies. They are fast-moving and strong.
evolve.race_reindeer_desc: The Reindeer are highly evolved herd animals. They are champion sled pullers and can haul huge loads of gifts.
evolve.race_rhinotaur_desc: Rhinotaur are tough, bestial creatures who have a large horn attached to their nose.
evolve.race_capybara_desc: The Capybara are highly-evolved giant rodents. They have sharp teeth that grow constantly and require grinding.
evolve.race_donkey_desc: The Donkey are highly resilient beasts adept to climbing mountains. They move through terrain too tough for reindeer.
evolve.race_bearkin_desc: The Bearkin are a race of bipedal ursine.
evolve.race_porkenari_desc: The Porkenari are an evolved warthog.
evolve.race_hedgeoken_desc: The Hedgeoken are a species descended from hedgehogs. They are covered in spines and can roll up into a spiky ball.
evolve.race_kobold_desc: Kobolds are small humanoid creatures who are known for their infatuation with candles. They are adept at hoarding as much stuff as possible.
evolve.race_goblin_desc: Goblins are small humanoid creatures who are known for their greed and cunning. They are highly intelligent but typically selfish in nature.
evolve.race_gnome_desc: Gnomes are small humanoid creatures who are known for their superior intelligence. They are natural scientists and seek to expand their knowledge, often at the cost of safety and morality.
evolve.race_ogre_desc: Ogres are large humanoid creatures who are known for being kind of dumb. They are very strong, with few races being able to match their physical prowess. However, they learn slowly.
evolve.race_cyclops_desc: Cyclops are large humanoid creatures who have a single giant eye. They have poor depth perception but are fairly social and intelligent.
evolve.race_troll_desc: Trolls are large humanoid creatures who are known for their regenerative powers. They are a hardy race highly resistant to disease and injury.
evolve.race_tortoisan_desc: Tortoisans are a reptilian species with %1$s shells on their backs. They are slow-moving and good at hiding.
evolve.race_ninja_turtle_desc: Ninja turtles are a species of %1$s shelled martial artist turtles that love pizza.
evolve.race_gecko_desc: The Geckos are a lizard species who can naturally camouflage themselves to their surroundings. They are very agile and fast-moving.
evolve.race_slitheryn_desc: Slitheryn are a reptilian species who evolved from snakes. They have humanoid upper bodies but retain snake-like lower halves.
evolve.race_arraak_desc: Arraak are a species of feathered birds. Modern Arraak aren't as adept at flying as their ancestors, but they can still glide.
evolve.race_turkey_desc: Turkey are a species of feathered birds. They taste great with gravy and a side of mashed potatoes.
evolve.race_pterodacti_desc: Pterodacti are descended from large, featherless flying creatures. Their skin is leathery and they have long, narrow heads.
evolve.race_dracnid_desc: Dracnid are descended from large, scaly flying creatures. They are tough due to their natural armor, but they tend to be antisocial and greedy.
evolve.race_entish_desc: Ents are basically sentient trees who can uproot themselves and move around. They are large and slow-moving, but fearsome and can get most of their nutrients from the sun.
evolve.race_spruce_desc: Spruce Ents are a special festive breed of ents who love to show off with decorations.
evolve.race_cacti_desc: Cacti are small sentient plant creatures covered in spines. They are surprisingly fast-moving, but easily startled.
evolve.race_pinguicula_desc: The Pinguicula are a plant-based species who are covered in a sticky film used to trap small prey. They are well suited to nutrient-poor environments.
evolve.race_sporgar_desc: Sporgar are a parasitic species of sentient mold spores that spread by infecting host bodies and possessing them.
evolve.race_shroomi_desc: The Shroomi are a race of mushroom-like creatures. They prefer dark places away from sunlight.
evolve.race_moldling_desc: The Moldling are a race of blob-like creatures made of a mass of mold which can shape itself into any form they please.
evolve.race_mantis_desc: Mantis are an insectoid species that resemble giant... mantis. They are quick but fragile.
evolve.race_scorpid_desc: Scorpid are a bipedal species with large claw hands and barbed tails. They are tough fighters naturally equipped for close combat.
evolve.race_antid_desc: Antid are a hivemind species descended from ants. Individually they are not intelligent, but as their swarm increases so does their collective intelligence.
evolve.race_sharkin_desc: Sharkin are an aquatic species descended from aggressive fish that have large mouths with many sharp teeth. Although they can roam on land, they prefer to stay underwater.
evolve.race_octigoran_desc: Octigoran are an aquatic species of cephalopod who have eight tentacles. They can mimic walking on land using their appendages as makeshift legs, but are most at home underwater.
evolve.race_dryad_desc: Dryads are forest creatures that are deeply connected to their trees. They can be quite ruthless if anyone threatens their trees.
evolve.race_satyr_desc: Satyrs are whimsical goat men that prefer to party rather than work. They are like a society of frat boys.
evolve.race_phoenix_desc: Phoenixes are avians that constantly emanate heat. When they die, they can sometimes self-resurrect in an explosion of fire.
evolve.race_salamander_desc: Salamanders are descended from lizards who evolved around lava flows. They can exhale intense flames and are not to be trifled with.
evolve.race_yeti_desc: Yeti are polar apes that dislike hot locations. For some reason, pictures of them are always blurry.
evolve.race_snowman_desc: Snowmen are animated piles of snow that appear in humanoid shapes.
evolve.race_wendigo_desc: Wendigos are horrific creatures that were born in the coldest climates. They have ravenous appetites which are never sated, and they feed only on the souls of other creatures.
evolve.race_krampus_desc: Krampus are horrific creatures that torment children who misbehave. They have ravenous appetites which are never sated, and they feed on the souls of those on the naughty list.
evolve.race_tuskin_desc: Tuskin evolved in the deserts and are normally hostile to anyone who is not part of their clan. They will often attack strangers for any resources they might provide.
evolve.race_kamel_desc: The Kamel are a race of humanoids with a giant hump on their back. They can go for long periods of time without drinking water.
evolve.race_balorg_desc: Balorg are a fiery race of demons who inhabit the abyss. Their skin literally burns with hellfire and few who gaze upon them live to tell the tale.
evolve.race_imp_desc: Imps are a small race of demonic creatures who delight in tormenting their victims with pranks that are far from harmless.
evolve.race_seraph_desc: Seraph are a race of angelic beings who inhabit the mountains of Eden. Although they champion the light, they won't hesitate to smite evil wherever it is found.
evolve.race_cherub_desc: Cherub are cute little chubby angelic beings. Although they resemble babies with wings, they won't hesitate to shoot you with an arrow through the heart.
evolve.race_unicorn_desc: Unicorns are mythical creatures of the light who roam the plains of Eden. Despite their reputation for good, unicorns are quite vicious when challenged.
evolve.race_emocorn_desc: The Emocorn have traded in the bright and cheery life of the unicorns for a dark and broody existence.
evolve.race_synth_desc: Synths are androids that have been covered in organic flesh to look just like their creator race. To an outside observer they appear indistinguishable from fully organic %1$s.
evolve.race_nano_desc: The Nano are swarms of tiny robots that work together to form larger entities. Each nano citizen is made up of trillions of individual nanites.
evolve.race_ghast_desc: The Ghast are a species of nightmarish dark-dwelling creatures that are fast, strong, and cannibalistic.
evolve.race_shoggoth_desc: Shoggoth are sentient amoeba-like blobs of flesh that can sprout eyes, mouths, and pseudopodia anywhere on their body at will.
evolve.race_dwarf_desc: Dwarves are short stocky humanoids known for their beards and love of alcohol.
evolve.race_raccoon_desc: Racconar are a species of highly evolved raccoons that love to tinker and have a habit of kleptomania.
evolve.race_lichen_desc: Lichen are a symbiotic creature that evolved as a strange blend of plant and fungi that blend together to make a single bush like creature.
evolve.race_wyvern_desc: Wyvern are a ferocious species of flying reptiles.
evolve.race_beholder_desc: Eye-Spectors are deadly giant floating eyeballs that dominate everything around them.
evolve.race_djinn_desc: Djinn are mystical creatures that are rumored to be able to grant wishes.
evolve.race_narwhal_desc: The Narwhalus are large mono-tusked creatures that evolved in the arctic regions. They are descendant from whales and have a single large tusk.
evolve.race_penguin_desc: The Pengino are large flightless birds that prefer to live in cold or moist environments.
evolve.race_bombardier_desc: The Bombardier are descended from beetles and can spit literal fireballs at anyone who challenges them.
evolve.race_nephilim_desc: Nephilim are descendants of an unholy union between celestial and demonic beings.
evolve.race_junker_desc: The Valdi are a genetic disaster; it's a wonder they have survived this long.
evolve.race_ghoul_desc: Draugrs come out to play when the barrier to the spirit world is weak.
evolve.race_sludge_desc: The Sludge are a pathetic genetic disaster of ooze made self aware; it's a wonder they can function at all.
evolve.race_ultra_sludge_desc: The Ultra Sludge are a repulsive genetic disaster of ooze made self aware; it's pretty bad, really just terrible, the worst.
evolve.race_hellspawn_desc: Hellspawn are literal spawn of the hell dimension.
evolve.genelab_genus_humanoid_desc: Humanoids are your standard bipedal creatures that are typically between 1.5-2 meters in height.
evolve.genelab_genus_carnivore_desc: Carnivorous Beasts are anthropomorphic creatures with a dietary preference for meat.
evolve.genelab_genus_herbivore_desc: Herbivorous Beasts are anthropomorphic creatures with a dietary preference for plants.
evolve.genelab_genus_omnivore_desc: Omnivorous Beasts are anthropomorphic creatures that will eat anything.
evolve.genelab_genus_small_desc: Small Humanoids are similar to regular humanoids in appearance but are usually around half the height.
evolve.genelab_genus_giant_desc: Giant Humanoids are similar to regular humanoids in appearance but are larger, typically exceeding 3 meters in height.
evolve.genelab_genus_reptilian_desc: Reptilians are cold-blooded creatures that evolved from reptiles.
evolve.genelab_genus_avian_desc: Avians are flying creatures that evolved from various types of birds.
evolve.genelab_genus_insectoid_desc: Insectoids are creatures that evolved from insect or arachnid species.
evolve.genelab_genus_plant_desc: These are creatures that have evolved from plants into a sentient and mobile species.
evolve.genelab_genus_fungi_desc: These are creatures that have evolved from fungi into a sentient and mobile species.
evolve.genelab_genus_aquatic_desc: Aquatic races evolved in the ocean and prefer water environments but can move on land.
evolve.genelab_genus_fey_desc: Fey races are mystical in nature and prefer forest environments.
evolve.genelab_genus_heat_desc: Heat races have high tolerance to hot environments and hate the cold.
evolve.genelab_genus_polar_desc: Polar races have high tolerance to cold environments and hate the heat.
evolve.genelab_genus_sand_desc: Sand races evolved in desert environments and prefer them to more lush landscapes.
evolve.genelab_genus_demonic_desc: Demonic creatures love hellish landscapes and prefer not to live in lush green places.
evolve.genelab_genus_angelic_desc: Angelic creatures love pristine landscapes and find anything less to be unsuitable.
evolve.genelab_genus_synthetic_desc: Synthetic creatures were made by another race, usually as servants, before gaining independence.
evolve.genelab_genus_eldritch_desc: Eldritch creatures are nightmarish horrors that live in subterranean cities. They often raid the surface world for thralls and resources.
evolve.genelab_genus_hybrid_desc: This species is a blend of two genera.
evolve.ui_ready: Evolution complete: %1$s (%2$s). Civilization rules await migration.
evolve.ui_confirm_new: Start a new game? Current progress will be replaced.
evolve.ui_confirm_load: Load the saved game and replace current progress?
evolve.ui_subtitle: From primordial life to a civilization
evolve.ui_start_civilization_desc: Begin gathering resources and researching technology.
evolve.ui_ready_supported: %1$s are ready to found a settlement.
evolve.ui_shed_effect: Increases lumber and stone storage capacity by %1$s each.
evolve.ui_smelter_wood_cost: Each operating wood slot consumes %1$s lumber per second.
evolve.ui_smelter_allocation_desc: Wood slots consume 3 lumber/s when fuel is available. Each operating iron slot adds 10%% iron production. Unassigned fuel refills one iron slot per simulation step.
evolve.ui_sawmill_effect: Increases lumber production by %1$s%% and storage capacity by %2$s.
evolve.ui_craftsman_capacity: Adds %1$s craftsman position shared by all recipes.
